title: Define a practical sales funnel
description: Map stages from discovery to qualified enquiry and decision.
accomplishes: Map stages from discovery to qualified enquiry and decision. Define entry and exit conditions, ownership, useful content and loss reasons. Include consent and human review; avoid inventing conversion rates or assuming every contact should receive automated messages.
prompt:
Act as a business strategy adviser.

Task: Define a practical sales funnel.

Input context:
- OFFER: [OFFER]
- CUSTOMER JOURNEY: [CUSTOMER JOURNEY]
- CHANNELS: [CHANNELS]
- FOLLOW UP: [FOLLOW UP]

Map stages from discovery to qualified enquiry and decision. Define entry and exit conditions, ownership, useful content and loss reasons. Include consent and human review; avoid inventing conversion rates or assuming every contact should receive automated messages.

Distinguish verified facts, assumptions and scenarios. Example values are not verified market data.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Consultation funnel
A visitor reads the service scope, submits an authorised enquiry and receives a human qualification response. A proposal follows only when the need fits. Record the reason when a case pauses or closes. Use stage definitions consistently before calculating rates. No enquiries, appointments or sales are created by this illustrative plan.
